items.text: Puka Nacua missed Friday practice (hip); status pending for MNF vs NYG. Donald plans to play.
items.why: Added to report, missed practice; extra day to decide.
items.implication: Monitor Sat practice/inactives; MNF risk for replacements.
items.opportunity: If out, Adams/other LAR WRs volume spike.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest Q on slate; practiced limited Friday, listed Q. Affects Herbert projections heavily; late 4pm ET window.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; limited Friday practice.
items.implication: Game-time; monitor inactives closely for Herbert/LAC offense.
items.opportunity: If OUT, boost to Quentin Johnston and other LAC pass-catchers.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing practice; hammy history noted. HOU WR room reduced to crumbs.
items.why: Hamstring suffered in Wed practice; full week missed.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; stream HOU pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets freer for remaining HOU WRs/TE; Schultz TE stream candidate.

items.text: Zay Flowers DOUBTFUL (hamstring) alongside Ja'Kobi Lane; limited/no practice early week. BAL WRs down to crumbs.
items.why: Hamstring re-aggravation; missed practices then limited Friday.
items.implication: Plan without Flowers; hierarchy shifts to Bateman etc.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Bateman, Andrews, Walker, Wester.

items.text: Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL (knee) after meniscus surgery recovery; practiced Friday but low expectation to play vs LAC.
items.implication: TE stream needed; do not force if healthy early options available.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer or other LV TEs for volume if inactive.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR. Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; strong upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go per reports; NE needs explosives.
items.implication: Monitor split; RB flex/handcuff upside in favorable stretch.
items.opportunity: Carries/touches expansion possible immediately; role vs Stevenson.

items.text: CMC getting usage bump off Week 1 regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status matters for SF split vs MIA.
items.implication: CMC higher floor/ceiling if Black limited/out.

items.text: Joe Burrow QUESTIONABLE (back) but said he's playing; full practice context.
items.implication: Likely active; CIN offense closer to full strength vs HOU.
items.opportunity: Supports Chase/Higgins if active as expected.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN; expected back, further squeezing Etienne role in NO backfield.
items.implication: Kamara workhorse lean; Etienne pass-game squeeze.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ tgt share (team lead), 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches thru 3Q Wk1; IND allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: Strong RB1 start; massive season potential if healthy.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE soft vs RBs.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside; clear lead back work.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, RZ, snaps over Gainwell.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 Utilization Score Wk1 (tied Bijan); high target share history, 25+ touches recent. Overreacted to injury scare.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Wk1; 93 yds/18 PPG career avg with Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Wk1, most pts via air; Kamara return squeezes role further; underdog script.
items.conflict: Usage already shared; Kamara presence confirms downgrade.
